reds: singleFlightWaiterMustSeeTheSameFallbackableFailureAsTheOwner: repro-expectation-obsolete. The repro asserts that the waiter gets an IllegalStateException, which was the old LMDB catch-clause type. The wp3 design (designs/wp3-plan-caching.design.json) deliberately changed this: FlightClaim.await() returns null for a failed flight and the waiter plans again. LmdbCascadesOptimizer now falls back on any planner RuntimeException except cancellation. So the robust intent (the waiter's query must not fail) holds, and PackedPlanningFailSafeTest covers it green (waiter replans, two failing owners, deadline). This is not a SPARQL-semantics question.

unsupportedOperatorMustSurfaceAsAFallbackableFailure: repro-expectation-obsolete, for the same reason. It now throws UnsupportedCascadesOperatorException, a CascadesPlanningException, before any cost session opens. PackedPlanningFailSafeTest#unsupportedOperatorFailsFastBeforeAnyCostSessionOpens and LmdbCascadesPlanningFailSafeTest#unsupportedOperatorFallsBackToThePipelineTree are green.

Not fixed: wiring the profile to them changes planning for users of those profiles, which is a product decision. Reported under openIssues.

reds: nestedOrdinaryPlannerReadStallsWherePriorityReadProceeds: repro-expectation-obsolete. It calls repeatedVariableCardinality directly from a thread that holds no query lease and has no pinned planning txn. wp8 deliberately routes planner reads through the query's pinned dataset txn, and when unpinned takes an ordinary lease so that a scan never occupies the single reserved slot. The review itself recommended pinning. The wp8 design explains that the repro 'asserts that an unrelated thread with no lease jumps the 127 ordinary waiters, which is not the bug'. The end-to-end repro in the same class (planning a repeated-variable query with one ordinary slot left) is green, and the ported LmdbPlannerReaderLeaseTest is green.

LEO rollout profiles: explainEnabled() and ruleSteeringEnabled() have no production consumer. Rule steering and reranking are enabled only by rdf4j.optimizer.lmdb.leoRuleSteering / leoPlanReranking. So OBSERVE_ONLY behaves like SHADOW_EXPLAIN and SAFE_PLAN_LIFECYCLE like SAFE_RULE_STEERING, and scripts/leo-workload-* 'steering' runs do not steer. SAFE_PLAN_RERANKING == EXPERIMENTAL_FULL by design. Needs a product decision: either wire the profile to the features or drop the ladder notion. LeoLearningReviewReproTest#rolloutLadderMustBeMonotone stays red until then.
